craft_notes: Sthāyin: enough-talk (devotion chewed to peace). Rows: row 1 (enough→sap). Close: shy (lajjate as landing: shyness closes even the closing). Rejected: 'silence' — kept shy (the verse speaks its shyness); 'love' for devotion — kept devotion (bhakti precise).

lines: No more of difference-talk. From chewing devotion's sap for you —
all this one, at peace, though saying so is shy.
l4.sanskrit_cite: alaṃ bhedānukathayā tvadbhaktirasacarvaṇāt | sarvamekamidaṃ śāntamiti vaktuṃ ca lajjate

reads_against.argmap: What is enough? → Enough of talking difference: devotion chewed to sap leaves all as one, at peace — and even saying so is shy.
c1_essence: Enough of difference-talk: devotion chewed to sap leaves all as one, at peace.
